title: One-Time Bank Draft Payments Toward TRICARE Prime Installments
content:
A beneficiary authorizes a one-time bank draft toward an installment of a fee-bearing **TRICARE Prime** enrollment; the amount of that one-time payment follows the TRICARE Prime fee rules, and no such payment is settled toward an enrollment that took effect in the current plan year.

## What the payment does

The beneficiary authorizes a one-time bank draft by electronic funds transfer. One payment is added to the enrollment's fee account against the installment named, made by electronic funds transfer with today's posting date, and the enrollment's fee balance owed falls by the amount paid. The beneficiary sees the payment confirmation with its reference number.

## Invocation

The tool is `pay_current_installment_by_bank_draft_694809d0`, a customer-side tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to authorize the draft. The agent reads the two reference numbers below from the lookups and gives them to the beneficiary.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `prime_enrollment_id` | the reference number of the beneficiary's fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment whose account is paid, read by the agent from the Prime enrollment lookup | identifier, as returned |
| `related_fee_entry_id` | the reference number of the installment charge being paid, read by the agent from the fee-account lookup for the enrollment | identifier, as returned |
| `amount` | the amount paid | US dollars, a plain number with 2 decimal places (cents, rounded half up), greater than 0.00 |

## Return

On success: `paid` (true when the payment was taken), `prime_fee_entry_id` (the payment's reference number, beginning "pfp"), `related_fee_entry_id` (the installment charge paid), `payment_method` (always electronic funds transfer), `amount` (USD, 2 decimals) and `fee_balance_due` (the fee balance owed after the payment, USD, 2 decimals; negative means a credit owed to the beneficiary). No other outcome is defined.

## Contract questions

**Can the draft be made by card or allotment?** No; this payment is always recorded as electronic funds transfer.

**Can the amount be 0.00?** No; the amount must be greater than 0.00.
